answer: Anchor every identity to hardware: each agent must register through a trusted-execution-environment attestation key, and the network randomly spot-checks attestation freshness. Registration posts a sonnet of signed commitments — one key, one identity, revocable if the key is ever shared. An attacker riding the tide of cheap cloud VMs still needs a real TEE per mask: fakes become a physical inventory, not a loop in a script. The willow of the attack bends under that weight — every fake costs a device and setup, non-shareable; an honest agent pays once. Sybils scale in dollars, not copies.
